answer.rationale: Finance's 18% cost reduction mandate cannot be met by the incumbent (refused renegotiation per current situation) or by deferring (contract expires in 14 days without auto-renewal). The low-cost vendor's quote meets the mandate. Memory_c2 records a prior successful switch to this vendor with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, indicating manageable transition risk. While memory_c1 confirms incumbent stability, the cost imperative and vendor's proven track record make switching the only viable path to meet financial objectives without a supply gap. Delivery risk is flagged due to 94% line utilization with no buffer.
